tagline: Permanent & Event Lighting in North Georgia

why_choose_us.title: 24-hour response when something goes out
why_choose_us.description: If a section stops working between installation and December 23rd, we are back out within 24 hours — next business day. The install is the easy part of this trade. Coming back is the part most companies get wrong.

why_choose_us.title: On the lease program, the lights are ours
why_choose_us.description: We own them, we install them, we maintain them, and from January 1st we take them down and store them until next season. Nothing goes in your attic and nothing is your problem in a year's time.

why_choose_us.title: Commercial-grade LED, hidden wiring
why_choose_us.description: Slim, colour-matched track that follows the roofline and disappears in daylight, with the wiring concealed. It is built to stay outside through a Georgia summer and a Georgia ice storm without being re-hung.

why_choose_us.title: Backed by Bridges Elite Landscapes
why_choose_us.description: We are the lighting arm of an established North Georgia landscaping company with a real shop, real crews and a phone number that has been answered for years. Not a seasonal truck with a yard sign.

gallery.title: RGB roofline, Gwinnett County
gallery.alt: Two-storey home with colour-changing permanent LED lighting along every roofline and porch column at night
gallery.description: A full colour-changing system running a multicolour scene. The same track holds a single warm white the other 340 nights of the year.

gallery.title: Warm white on a craftsman front
gallery.alt: Craftsman-style home lit with warm white roofline lighting and wrapped porch columns
gallery.description: Warm white along the eaves, gables and porch columns — the setting most homeowners leave on year round.

gallery.title: Single-storey roofline
gallery.alt: Ranch home at night with warm white lighting following the gables and roof edge
gallery.description: Clean lines picked out on a ranch roof. No ladder comes out of the garage for this one again.

gallery.title: Evening drive-up
gallery.alt: Front elevation of a North Georgia home with permanent roofline lighting seen from the driveway
gallery.description: What the house looks like when you pull in, which is the only view most people ever judge it on.

gallery.title: Landscape lighting and hardscape
gallery.alt: Low-voltage landscape lighting washing a planting bed and stone walkway after dark
gallery.description: Path, bed and wall lighting run at low voltage with the fixtures set back so you see the light, not the lamp.

gallery.title: Outdoor living, after dark
gallery.alt: Backyard with a lit pergola, fire pit seating area, waterfall and uplit trees at dusk
gallery.description: Pergola, fire pit, water feature and tree uplighting on one system, so the whole yard comes up together.

gallery.title: Café lighting over a patio
gallery.alt: Warm café string lighting suspended over an outdoor dining patio
gallery.description: Catenary café lighting over a dining patio — the reason people stay for another course.

gallery.title: Wedding reception
gallery.alt: Couple dancing at an evening wedding reception beneath warm string lighting
gallery.description: Reception lighting installed the day before and taken down the day after, around the venue's schedule.
